Title: About Page — Story, Philosophy & Contact
Summary: Authoritative reference for the about.html page: structure, content sections, contact card, and active-page navigation.
Content:
## Overview

The about page (`about.html`) provides background on the Cyréna project, the review philosophy, app features, and contact information.

## HTML Structure

- `<header class="site-header">` — shared sticky header with `aria-current="page"` on About link.
- `<section class="hero hero-small">` — smaller hero with "About Cyréna" heading and subtitle.
- `<section class="content-section">` — "The Story" — origin and motivation.
- `<section class="content-section alt-bg">` — "Review Philosophy" — 5 criteria (Accuracy, Reliability, Tool use, Context awareness, Developer experience).
- `<section class="content-section">` — "The Cyréna App" — key features list.
- `<section class="content-section alt-bg">` — "Get in Touch" — contact card for Christo Cilliers.
- `<footer class="site-footer">` — shared footer with `aria-current="page"` on About link.

## Key Components

### Hero Small
- `.hero-small` reduces vertical padding compared to the home hero.
- Heading size is smaller (`clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.75rem)`).

### Content Sections
- `.content-section` uses left-aligned headings and `max-width: 70ch` for readability.
- `.alt-bg` alternates to `--color-surface` for visual rhythm.
- `.styled-list` is a disc list with strong labels for each item.

### Contact Card
- `.contact-card` is a bordered card with shadow, max-width `400px`.
- Contains `.contact-name`, email link (`mailto:info@vayanova.co.za`), and two external links (`vayanova.co.za`, `cyrena.dev`).
- Links use `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

## Accessibility
- Sections use `aria-labelledby`.
- Active page indicated via `aria-current="page"` in both header and footer.

## Asset References
- `css/styles.css`
- `js/main.js`
- Page links back to `index.html` with hash anchors.
